review_method: selected static review, exact blob comparisons, and reading recorded acceptance; no runtime execution

items.name: HTTP identity
items.boundary: Bearer tokens resolve on the server; caller identity headers are replaced.

items.name: Route inventory
items.boundary: Descriptors declare capability/risk; they do not prove complete handlers.

items.name: Memory creation/revision
items.boundary: Memory/revision/source/search commit together; the service persists outbox/idempotency separately.

items.name: HTTP/MCP memory reads
items.boundary: Current MemoryResponse exposes metadata, not content or the active revision number.

items.name: External library/history
items.boundary: MW proposes list/detail/history; internal revisions do not imply available public routes.

items.name: HTTP ContextPack
items.boundary: The response summarizes context without sections/rendered content.

items.name: Token accounting
items.boundary: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4) is an estimate, not an exact arbitrary-model counter.

items.name: Exact historical references
items.boundary: The hydrator reads the requested revision without substituting the current revision.

items.name: One worker cycle
items.boundary: Exit 0/3/1 distinguishes work, idle, and error; it does not qualify the whole Run.

items.name: Historical P04/14D ResultPrepared
items.boundary: 14D acceptance ended at ResultPrepared. Later 14E acceptance is recorded separately; this historical verdict is not expanded.

items.name: P04 completion after Task 14E
items.boundary: The supplied evidence approves Task 14E only, preserves the rotation-before-adoption deferral, and leaves P04/G0/v1.0 incomplete. No tests were rerun here.

items.name: Console memory editor
items.boundary: A presentation component exists; a complete library/editor route is not in the reviewed router.

items.name: Source import/synchronization
items.boundary: The MW documentation specifies the selected extension; it is not implementation evidence.

items.name: Portable JSON/Markdown
items.boundary: The MW specification is not a working exporter.

items.name: Keys and content materials
items.boundary: Lifecycle primitives do not qualify every read/import/erasure path.

items.name: v1.0 release readiness
items.boundary: Packages, tests, and documents do not replace P12 qualification on the shipping target.
